cards.title: Exact independent MH noise costs and a certified dependent trace enclosure
cards.scientific_scope: Existence and cost of positive scalar regularization for a fixed symmetrized Margenau–Hill reporting identity. The independent dichotomic theorem and arbitrary-dependent unit-Pauli enclosure have different quantifiers. No improved quantum information or acquired instrument is claimed.
cards.statement: Let A=aU,B=bV with a,b>0 and bounded self-adjoint involutions on any complex Hilbert space, [U,V]!=0. There exist independent positive scalar laws of finite variances v1,v2 and a normalized POVM satisfying Mhat(s,t)=nuhat1(s)nuhat2(t)(exp(isA)exp(itB)+exp(itB)exp(isA))/2 at every real s,t exactly when v1>0,v2>0 and v1*v2>=||[A,B]||^2. Every such pair is attained; for positive weights w1,w2, min(w1*v1+w2*v2)=2*sqrt(w1*w2)*||[A,B]||. For arbitrary dependent finite-covariance scalar laws regularizing the unit orthogonal Pauli MH kernel, C*=min tr Cov(nu) is attained and lies in [3.1763613,3.1763622]. Its exact value and a symbolic optimizer remain UNKNOWN.
assumptions: The independent theorem is existential over admissible laws; a specified pair of laws is not characterized by its variances alone.
Independence is required for the product frontier; atoms and singular measures are permitted, means are unrestricted.
The dependent interval concerns the unit orthogonal Pauli pair and normalized trace; it is not an arbitrary weighted physical-trace theorem.
Both contracts require the full Fourier identity at every real frequency, not only low moments or a finite grid.
proof_spine: Reduce positivity to likelihood contrasts eta_j and the exact operator inequality 1-eta1^2-eta2^2+(1-delta^2)eta1^2*eta2^2>=0, delta=||[U,V]||/2.
A one-shift likelihood-ratio domination lemma gives Var(nu_j)>=2*a_j^2*(eta_j^-2-1); global-mean residue disintegration handles arbitrary Borel laws and classifies equality.
Two-sided geometric laws on 2aZ and 2bZ attain every independent feasible pair; weighted AM–GM gives the optimum.

For dependence, disintegrate over R^2/(2Z^2), retain the between-fiber covariance cost, apply rational infinite-lattice SOC duals and exact interpolation across all means, and certify an infinite geometric-tail upper law.
cards.costs: The explicit N=10 upper POVM has 484 oriented Bloch vectors / 242 antipodal binary measurement types, with at most one projective qubit measurement per copy plus classical labels. Its exact ideal noise sampler uses <224 unbiased random bits in expectation; the antipodal-pair choice uses <226 before the binary POVM. Algebraic visibility coins terminate almost surely; exact labels/runtime are unbounded. Catalog preparation, calibrated axes, rotations, physical copies, finite precision, energy and reset are separate supplied/unknown resources. No acquired device is certified.
cards.information_acquisition: The dichotomic operator architecture, a,b and commutator norm are supplied mathematical inputs. The unit-Pauli dependent problem is normalized. Norm acquisition, physical calibration, access to a state and actual measurement hardware are not supplied by the theorem. The finite resource construction additionally assumes calibrated Pauli axes, fresh identical qubit copies, unbiased random bits, exact ideal rational arithmetic and selected-axis projective measurement access; those physical resources are not acquired by a table proof.
cards.obstruction: The independent product constraint cannot be transferred to arbitrary dependence. Conversely the dependent interval does not identify C* exactly. Independent Gaussians of variance 3 each have product 9>4 yet fail MH positivity, so the feasible-pair theorem is not a variance-only law test.
cards.comparator: Independent normalized unit-Pauli covariance trace minimum is 4 versus the dependent enclosure [3.1763613,3.1763622]. Ordinary unbiased joint measurements reach trace 2 under their weaker contract. For the explicit dependent upper law with exact covariance trace C_explicit, n-copy trace MSE for two Pauli means is (2+C_explicit-r_z^2-r_x^2)/n, strictly worse than separate equal-copy projective allocation (4-2r_z^2-2r_x^2)/n; the difference is (C_explicit-2+r_z^2+r_x^2)/n>0. C_explicit is not the unknown optimum C*.
cards.missing_lemma: Exact C* and a symbolic optimizer remain open. The ideal finite measurement/sampling realization is now explicit, but physical calibration/acquisition/finite-precision costs are unacquired. No advantage for the two Pauli means can be claimed against the supplied separate-allocation comparator; another operational task requires its own matched comparison.
